descriptionFull: The rook ( Corvus frugilegus ) is a member of the family Corvidae in the passerine order of birds. It was given its binomial name by Carl Linnaeus in 1758, The binomial is from Latin; Corvus is for "raven", and frugilegus is Latin for "fruit-gathering", from frux, frugis , "fruit", and legere , "to pick". The English name is ultimately derived from the bird's harsh call.
